name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport wasn't straightforward. Originally trained as a mechanical engineer, he found himself drawn to the precision and high stakes of racing after attending a local rally event. He started volunteering with smaller teams, quickly proving his meticulous eye for detail. This led to opportunities at higher levels, where he honed his expertise in quality assurance.

At Team Gtechniq, Ricardo is known for his unwavering commitment to maintaining the highest standards. He believes that even the smallest imperfection can have significant consequences on the track. His approach blends traditional quality control methodologies with innovative data analysis techniques to proactively identify and address potential issues. 

Ricardo's colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to communicate complex technical issues in a clear and concise manner. His passion for precision and his dedication to pushing the boundaries of quality control make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn diagrams.
Insists on calibrating his own measuring tools before each inspection.
Has a habit of humming quietly while concentrating.
